summary: Destructor for a container that holds an array of 16-byte list elements (count at this+0x0, array pointer at this+0x8) and three embedded singly-linked lists (heads at this+0xC, this+0x1C, this+0x2C). Fully destroys every element: iterators for the array and each sub-list are destroyed via ListIteratorFullDestruction, the array block and each list node are freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf (array elements additionally via LinkedListDestructor_1db0, first-sub-list values via EmptyStub_0170), and each sub-list head block is zeroed. Always returns 0. Invoked by ConditionalDestructor_1740.

operations.description: Array destruction loop runs only while the element count at this+0x0 is greater than 0.
do-while loop over the array of 16-byte elements rooted at this+0x8, iterating *this (this+0x0) times with a 16-byte stride.
ListIteratorFullDestruction(v3 + this[2]) destroys each 16-byte array element iterator during the loop.
ListIteratorFullDestruction(this + 3) destroys the first sub-list iterator at this+0xC.
ListIteratorFullDestruction(this + 7) destroys the second sub-list iterator at this+0x1C.
ListIteratorFullDestruction(this + 11) destroys the third sub-list iterator at this+0x2C.
Array block release runs only while the array pointer this[2] (this+0x8) is non-null.
The array element cursor walks the block backwards from this[2] using the element count stored in the 4-byte header preceding the block (this[2] - 4).
Backwards do-while loop calling LinkedListDestructor_1db0 on each 16-byte array element until the countdown reaches zero.
FreeWrapper_7bcf releases the whole array block, freeing the header at this[2] - 4.
EmptyStub_0170(this + 15) runs against the trailing 4-DWORD region beginning at this+0x3C.

Walk of the third sub-list at this+0x2C: reads the value pointer (this+0x2C node +0x0), the flags byte (+0x8) and the next pointer (+0x4) of each node, frees every node with FreeWrapper_7bcf, and calls ShortComputation_1e60(1) when the flags byte and value pointer of a node are both non-zero.
Zeroes the four DWORDs of the third sub-list head block at this+0x2C through this+0x38.

Walk of the second sub-list at this+0x1C: reads the value pointer (this+0x1C node +0x0), the flags byte (+0x8) and the next pointer (+0x4) of each node, frees every node with FreeWrapper_7bcf, and calls ShortComputation_1e60(1) when the flags byte and value pointer of a node are both non-zero.
Zeroes the four DWORDs of the second sub-list head block at this+0x1C through this+0x28.

Walk of the first sub-list at this+0xC: reads the value pointer (this+0xC node +0x0), the flags byte (+0x8) and the next pointer (+0x4) of each node, frees every node with FreeWrapper_7bcf, and for nodes whose flags byte is non-zero additionally passes the node's value pointer to EmptyStub_0170 and frees it with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zeroes the four DWORDs of the first sub-list head block at this+0xC through this+0x18.
Called by ConditionalDestructor_1740 as part of container teardown.

clean_pseudocode: do { ListIteratorFullDestruction(base + this[2]); ++idx; base += 16; } while (idx < this[0]);
unresolved: The semantics of ShortComputation_1e60 and EmptyStub_0170 (beyond being invoked conditionally on node state) are unknown here.
The layout meaning of the four DWORDs at this+0x3C that EmptyStub_0170(this + 15) receives is unknown.
The owning class behind this+0x0 / this+0x8 / this+0xC is unknown.
